verdict.rationale: CDP offers event-driven building blocks — webhooks for real-time notifications on wallet/payment activity, and built-in auto-liquidation/auto-convert triggered on fund receipt — that let a developer wire up automation, but there is no documented user-facing rules engine where an AI-native user declaratively defines 'if event X then action Y' logic; the developer must write the handling logic themselves. missing for 10: a declarative rules/automation engine, conditional logic support, or evidence of no-code rule definitions tied to webhook events.
